title: Seahawks ‘probably’ would have cut Terrion Arnold if new corner was on roster before kidnapping arrest

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks ‘probably’ would have cut Terrion Arnold if new corner was on roster before kidnapping arrest
sources.description: The Lions released Arnold in June following his arrest stemming from an alleged February incident. He's facing charges that could lead to a life sentence in jail.
